author: KEXP
description: At the cross section of medieval fantasy and heavy metal hails the Brooklyn band Castle Rat. Our latest in-studio session invites the band alongside 'The Rat Queen' to share a performance of "SIREN" and more.
title: Castle Rat performs "SIREN" and more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
